services.name: Parasail
services.desc: When flying tandem you are guaranteed 12-15 minutes in the air. The boat ride itself can last up to 90 minutes. Most flights are done tandem, so you can enjoy the ride with some company. However, if you want to fly solo, that is also an option. We are the only parasailing operation in Atlantic City, and as such we are the only way (short of a helicopter) to see the AC skyline the way it was meant to be seen - from the sky. Weight limit at Captain's A ride with a view! · $95/person
